posts.title: Musings on ‘Genius’
posts.description: “Kate Bush was no genius,” says some yob on Reddit. Just a throwaway comment, requiring no response or rebuttal. posts.title: Open Historical Type Revivals
posts.description: On the occasion of doing a bit of a design refresh on this blog, using the amazing new Baskerville Punch typefaces, I was moved to write about the larger world of historical type being re-drawn, enhanced, and released online under open licences. posts.title: Summer of Ice Cream
posts.description: 2026 was the summer of ice cream. It began when we were in Europe: Vilnius seemed to have little ice cream stands here and there in the Old City, and really nice stuff, too – home-made flavours with cool additions and whatnot.
